description: This file contains helper functions and classes for PUCCH (Physical Uplink Control Channel) resource allocation and management in a 5G NR (New Radio) scheduler, including functions for scrambling ID calculation, PDU handling, and resource matching.

classes.name: pucch_existing_pdus_handler
classes.description: Handler class for managing existing PUCCH PDUs, including creation, updating, and removal of PUCCH resource grants.

methods.name: get_n_id0_scrambling
methods.description: Calculates the scrambling ID 0 based on UE configuration and cell PCI, following 3GPP TS 38.211 specifications.

methods.name: sr_id_match
methods.description: Checks if a given PUCCH resource configuration matches a specific SR (Scheduling Request) info.

methods.name: get_sr_pucch_resource
methods.description: Retrieves the PUCCH resource associated with SR from the configuration.

methods.name: pucch_existing_pdus_handler::get_next_pdu
methods.description: Provides the next available PUCCH PDU for resource allocation.

methods.name: pucch_existing_pdus_handler::remove_unused_pdus
methods.description: Removes unused PDUs associated with a specific RNTI from the list.

methods.name: pucch_existing_pdus_handler::update_sr_pdu_bits
methods.description: Updates the bits for an SR PDU and marks it as used.

methods.name: pucch_existing_pdus_handler::update_csi_pdu_bits
methods.description: Updates the bits for a CSI PDU.

methods.name: pucch_existing_pdus_handler::update_harq_pdu_bits
methods.description: Updates the bits for a HARQ PDU and recomputes resource allocations based on format.
